notes: Owner direction: the terminal's Export PDF button no longer writes the report into the server's state directory and prints a file path — it requests the new GET /pf/report.pdf route and the browser performs an ordinary file download (application/pdf, attachment; filename "<subject <date>.pdf"), with nothing written to disk on the way. A refusal answers as plain text with a 4xx status, so the sentence reaches the user verbatim instead of being saved as a broken .pdf. The MCP tool export_portfolio_report keeps its agent-facing contract unchanged: same assembly, written to <statedir>/reports, pat
